routes.question: Can an integer projection of the Rao--Rosenfeld h6 fixed point remain additive-square-free?
premises: h6 is the cited six-letter 3-uniform morphism
letters have the cited Z^2 weights
projection is (x,y) -> p*x+q*y with primitive integers (p,q)
routes.method: generate the fixed point exactly and mark the primitive perpendicular direction of every nonzero adjacent-block difference vector
routes.failure_reason: All 12,176 primitive directions of height at most 100 are killed within the first 30,000 symbols; this bounded failure does not cover higher directions.
routes.next_test: Use template/factor structure rather than quadratic prefix scans to decide directions above height 100.

routes.question: Can a low-expansion primitive morphism meet the Rao--Rosenfeld finite-ancestor criterion after scalar weighting?
premises: expanding eigenspace intersects the length-and-sum kernel trivially
routes.method: spectral filtering followed by finite forbidden-template ancestor verification
routes.next_test: Synthesize 4-letter morphisms beyond uniform modulus 2; modulus 2 is excluded by D02.

routes.question: Can van der Waerden coloring of prefix sums force exact zero second difference for every bounded-increment walk?
premises: color n by S_n modulo m
use a monochromatic three-term progression of indices
routes.method: combine modular divisibility with an Archimedean bound on the second difference
routes.failure_reason: The progression length supplied for modulus m is not bounded independently of m, so divisibility by m does not force the length-dependent second difference to vanish.
routes.next_test: A repair must couple modulus and scale without assuming m > 2*diam(A)*W(m,3).

routes.question: Can a 2-uniform endomorphism on four symbols, prolongable on one symbol, have an additive-square-free fixed point under any integer weighting?
routes.method: complete enumeration of 4^7 morphisms and exact abelian-square detection
routes.next_test: Do not extrapolate to codings, more state symbols, nonuniform morphisms, or uniform modulus at least 3.

routes.question: What affine and reflection normalizations preserve the exact problem?
premises: the compared blocks have equal length
routes.method: subtract the two transformed block sums and divide by the common nonzero multiplier
routes.next_test: Use only primitive minimum-zero representatives and one representative of each reflection pair.

routes.question: When do arbitrarily long finite ASF words give an infinite word?
routes.method: König's infinity lemma on the finitely branching prefix tree
routes.next_test: Reject every argument that lets A vary with the depth.

routes.question: What are the exact maxima for all primitive normalized four-letter integer alphabets with maximum letter at most 5, modulo reflection?
routes.method: canonical alphabet enumeration and complete exact ASF prefix-tree traversal
routes.next_test: Any extension to maximum 6 requires a new complete certificate; no monotonicity in the maximum letter is assumed.

routes.question: Does an implementation independent of discovery reconstruct every finite-census claim from serialized input?
routes.method: compile a separate verifier, rerun all seven trees, compare exact invariants, and inject malformed certificates
routes.next_test: Freeze hashes in the release manifest after manuscript completion.

routes.question: Can the certified finite statements be mistaken for a solution of the infinite problem?
premises: h6 screen only has height<=100 and prefix<=30000
morphism census only has uniform modulus 2 and four states
routes.method: quantifier reconstruction from definitions and explicit counter-scope checks
routes.next_test: Any future extension must repeat this quantifier audit for its enlarged scope.
